steps.name: validate_request
steps.description: Validate simulation parameters, check boundary temperatures, and ensure grid dimensions are valid positive integers.

steps.name: run_heat_simulation
steps.description: Execute 2D finite-difference heat diffusion simulation using numerical methods over 100 steps.

steps.name: validate_results
steps.description: Verify numerical stability, check conservation of energy, and check if final temperatures exceed the 80.0 review threshold.

steps.name: generate_report
steps.description: Generate visual temperature profile, compile statistics, and export simulation results.
